thread:
sam-cs: Heads-up: Orchid's variant (different account) reports 401 spikes then big 429 bursts during onboarding matrix. Need triage.
leo-se: likely token rotation stampede + proxy header loss. Any request samples?
sam-cs: from customer:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer eyJxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{"input":"test"}
```
Response: 401 sometimes, then ~30s of 429s. They use edgebridge v2 keep-alive pools.
priya-sre: edgebridge has known HTTP/2 stream reuse bug that can drop Authorization on reused streams. If runners all refresh tokens at once we get 401 -> retries -> rate limit.
mei-soleng: short term advice to customer?
leo-se: 1) increase ephemeral TTL to >=120s if possible; 2) add jittered startup and randomized refresh; 3) cache token per runner; 4) backoff on 401.
sam-cs: sent snippet for JS jitter and staggered start. They can change CI today but can't patch edgebridge.
edgebridge-bot: logs: 98 requests from orchid.ci between 1771234520-1771234555; 12 missing Authorization on stream reuse.
priya-sre: I'll enable a temporary org-level smoothing rule (20s window) and a soft-queue behavior to avoid immediate 429s.
mei-soleng: I'll add checklist note: avoid <60s TTL in CI, add jitter, and validate proxy preserves auth on keep-alive.
leo-se: create support ticket CS-3802 and schedule vendor follow-up. Add alert for 401->429 chain for new orgs.
sam-cs: done. Customer agreed to stagger CI and test. Follow-up after vendor sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
